# BREAKING: Slop Company Disbands GOC Over NSFW Comments in Server With Minors

Slop Company has disbanded the Global Occult Coalition (GOC) and shut down its server, according to Slop Company moderator @SLOP STAFF | findog Finn.

According to Slop Company Staff @SLOP STAFF | findog , GOC's owner was banned for making NSFW suggestive comments in a server with minors, in violation of Discord's Terms of Service. Other members were banned for similar NSFW suggestive content. All remaining members were asked to leave, and GOC is no longer affiliated with Slop Company.

GOC's owner confirmed the ban to BCBN.

It is not yet clear how GOC's disbandment affects the TSU alliance, of which GOC was a founding member.

More information will follow.
